title: P3 regressions: 7 test files broke after global-pointer removal
summary: After P3 achieved grep-zero on state.workspace/state.overlay/state.graphStore (committed 88af373 on orch/attempt/d7674989-1220-4c98-b891-80ca9e2e803b-4), the full suite is 150/167. Beyond the ~10 environmental baseline (orch-gate*, cursor*, codex-hooks, classify-hook*, dispatcher-model, judge-hook-nudge; schedule-wakeup flaky), SEVEN files are GENUINE REGRESSIONS — each verified PASS on base d95f1d8 and FAIL on 88af373: (1) workspace-fallback-warn — `daemon.__resetWorkspaceFallbackSeamsForTest is not a function`: P3 removed the P1 warn scaffold+export but not its test; the warn is intentionally superseded by 400, so update/remove the test, don't restore the warn. (2) apply-patch-confinement — `ENOENT lstat '...\undefined'` on "attempt worktree created": REAL CODE BUG — worktree/repo resolution falls to a literal `undefined` path when no global/explicit repo; must 400 or use explicit repo, never path.join(undefined,...). (3) filedrop-daemon — 1 assertion "(D) terminal status folded into snapshot": sweep now enumerates registeredWorkspaces(); test ws likely not registered. (4) note-edge-structboost — "three notes created"/"baseline boosted note retrieved"/"createEdge applied" fail: note create/retrieve/edge endpoints relied on global; pass explicit workspace or fix route. (5) per-repo-workspace-scoping — pins "workspace to B (daemon global)"; rewrite for no-global selection. (6) phase2-integration — "(B) local/cursor status write accepted"/"write-through hit stub": status write-through relied on global; pass explicit ws or fix. (7) should-stop-advisory — "clean call still executes"/"flagged agent gets should_stop": stopSignalFor/advisory resolution needs explicit ws. CLASSIFY EACH as test-relied-on-global (→ update test to pass explicit workspace; behavior change is intended) vs production-regression (→ fix code: missing ws = 400, never undefined path). Commit per fix for resilience.
